requirement: Create an antibiotic group: when a parent ID is supplied the parent must exist and must not be soft-deleted, otherwise the command is rejected; then map the command, persist the new group, and return its generated ID with Created status.

preconditions.text: A live parent antibiotic group exists for the requested parent ID
The requested parent ID does not match any live antibiotic group

inputs.text: Root group (Beta-lactams) with a null parent ID
Subgroup (Penicillins) with the ID of an existing parent
Subgroup (Cephalosporins) with an unknown parent ID
Subgroup (Gentamicin subgroup) with a soft-deleted parent ID

returns.text: Success with Created status and the new group ID
The group is persisted with the requested name, description, and parent ID
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Antibiotic group parent ID not found' error
No group is created when the parent check fails

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing parent is returned as a failed Result
